M-SPRING-BEHAVIOR.Purpose: Physical spring integration: accelerate a value toward a target governed by tension, mass and damping until it settles.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: SpringBehavior<T>: tension/mass/damping parameters, velocity state, settle detection.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Spring authoring facade with parameter presets. Fixed-duration motion — owned by M-TWEEN-BEHAVIOR.

Requirements.REQ-001: The spring settles when velocity and remaining distance fall below epsilon, then reports Finished per SS-BEHAVIOR-PRIMITIVES.REQ-002.
Requirements.REQ-002: Changing the target mid-flight keeps current velocity (no restart).

Outputs.OUT-001: value: T — integrated position each Update.

M-SPRING-BEHAVIOR.Codemap: * `SpringBehavior<T>` : `Behavior<T>` * `SpringBehavior<T>.Update(deltaTime)` -> integrate(tension, mass, damping, velocity) => value == target + velocity == 0 * `Spring.To<T>(...)` + `Spring.From<T>(...)` + `Spring.FromTo<T>(...)` + `Spring.State<T>(...)` -> `SpringBehavior<T>`
